Sign in on the crypto market to see the order book.

The price and the chart for this market are public and work without an account, but the order book comes from a route that needs this platform\'s own session. Trying again without signing in gives the same answer.
The order book is unavailable.
Check the connection and load it again.
The exchange is not responding right now.
Your connection and the server are both fine; it is the exchange that is unreachable. Try again shortly.
The server is not ready to relay the book yet.
The problem is on the server side and there is nothing to do at your end. Try again shortly.
Try again
There are no resting orders right now.
The exchange returned the book and it was empty: a market with nothing waiting on it. This is not an error, and trying again will not change it.
The number on a bar is how many orders rest at that level, shown only from %1$s orders upwards; about nine levels in ten hold a single order.
The book refreshes once a second while this screen is open — roughly 4 MB an hour. Leaving the screen stops it.
Price aggregation
Raw
Amount
Cumulative

Aggregating folds neighbouring levels into one row and gives the price column the step\'s own decimal places. Bids round down onto their bucket and asks round up onto theirs, so the spread can only widen, never tighten.
Depth curve
Market depth curve. The deepest cumulative volume is %1$s, over the price band %2$s to %3$s.
